policy.sha256: pinned at the lock commit (the 5C.4h candidate's digest is given in protocol §1)

streams.family: F: the reserved PCG(20261201, ·) for the confirmatory run (refused by this build); PCG(20261021, ·) for the development construction checks; PCG(1, ·) for the suite's construction test
streams.demand: seed i of every scenario: PCG(F, 2·i) for both plans (identical exogenous demand within each pair, the same seed i in every scenario)
streams.candidateBooking: PCG(F, 20000000 + 100000·k + i); booking 'baseline': the baseline's stream (identical records before injection)
streams.candidateInjection: PCG(F, 30000000 + 100000·k + i): first draw the harm assignment when harmProbability is set, then the injection's draws in record order; replicates continue the same stream
streams.reuse: a scenario with baseScenario b uses scenario b's pairs (b's booking streams, seeds 0…seeds−1) and its own k for injection
streams.disjointness: k < 100 and i < 100000: every role's range [role, role + 10^7) is disjoint from the others and from the demand streams (even, below 200000)

practices.*: the fidelity model (internal/eval/oc_fidelity_test.go ocFidelityScenarios) at the aligned takeover (fidAlignedTakeover), with exogenous modalities (exogenousModality: each order's modality drawn with its demand and carried by its study, as in the simulator, so that case selection's modality strata pair) and prefix-stable draws (prefixStableDraws: each study's documentation and read times drawn from its order's identity, so that a longer observation leaves every earlier outcome unchanged); IL40-85: A85 with imaging capacity 0.6 from day 30; volumeCycle: the demand-rate multiplier of seed i is volumeCycle[i mod length], the same for both plans
